scope: All five later checkpoints used the complete evaluation sets in the original project pipeline.
interpretation: The author confirmed full-dataset evaluation. Counts are mapped to the corresponding complete evaluation split recorded at step 6499; this does not mean combining training, validation and test partitions.

humaneval.population: Complete HumanEval / EvalPlus problem set; Base and Plus score the same 164 problems.

mbpp.population: Complete 378-problem MBPP / EvalPlus evaluation split used by this project, not all partitions of the source MBPP dataset.

cruxeval.population: Complete 800-problem evaluation set for each of CRUXEval-I and CRUXEval-O.

mmlu.population: Complete 14,042-question MMLU evaluation population in the archived pipeline. This count does not assign later results to the MC5 or CF prompt protocol.

notes: These are author-confirmed problem counts, not counts recovered from later per-example logs.
The sample-count update does not establish a dataset revision/hash, prompt, shot count, decoding rule or number of generated responses.
Correct counts, per-example outcomes, runtime timestamps and checkpoint fingerprints are not inferred from published accuracy.
Early n_archived and passed_archived fields remain separate and are not changed.
